The factory stays idle. No wrapping, copying, or promise settlement hook is added.

KEY ABSENT
Call factory → store exact return.
Returns P → insert P now
Throws → insertion is never reached

A thrown factory runs again on the next lookup. In reference discovery, the function runs before Promise.resolve receives its argument.

const value = createValue();
this.values.set(key, value);
return value;
